## Overview

This example demonstrates the `sdb build --website --publish` pipeline.

- It generates a full website via `--website`
- Then produces publishable artifact bundles in `_publish/`
- The bundle includes TeX sources, PDF, clean markdown, and metadata

## Test Targets

The following targets are configured:

| Target | Format | Description |
|--------|--------|-------------|
| index  | html   | Landing page (website) |
| paper  | pdf    | Academic paper (publish bundle) |

## Configuration

The `build.yml` enables `publish` section with Zenodo sandbox metadata:

```yaml
publish:
  zenodo:
    sandbox: true
    metadata:
      creators:
        - name: "Test Author"
          affiliation: "SSCCS"
      license: "CC-BY-4.0"
```
